title: Stemma target projection profile (v1)
description: Stored at .stemma/profiles/<target>.json. A profile controls delivery, never meaning: it may move an entity, change how it activates for one target, exclude it, or accept a known lossy mapping. Replacing the text requires contentOverride, which always produces STEMMA3601.

acceptedDiagnostics.description: Diagnostic fingerprints that have been reviewed. Accepted diagnostics are downgraded to info and stop blocking apply.

include.description: Force the entity in or out of this target. It can never re-enable an entity disabled in the canonical project.

activation.description: Replaces the canonical activation for this target only. Same shape as the canonical activation union.

directory.description: Repository-relative destination directory. Must not escape the workspace.

filename.description: Destination file name. Must not contain a path separator.

contentOverride.description: Target-specific wording. Always reported with STEMMA3601.
